profile.name: Aakash Kumar
profile.role: Product Lead | Platform Engineering & DevSecOps Automation
profile.headline: Enterprise Vulnerability Remediation Command Center
profile.subheadline: Owner-led remediation governance for regulated infrastructure, platform automation, and AI-ready operations
profile.summary: Platform engineering and DevSecOps leader with 6+ years of experience building enterprise automation in banking and financial services environments. I lead and own a vulnerability remediation workflow that translates scanner-driven findings into dashboards, ownership mapping, host tagging, mitigation planning, and tracked execution across Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, Jenkins, and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform. The platform is designed for 4,000+ servers, enforces lower-environment-first patching, and is being shaped toward agentic remediation and AI-assisted root-cause analysis.
profile.location: Pune, India • Open to Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Dubai
profile.focus: Enterprise vulnerability remediation, DevSecOps workflow orchestration, and platform ownership

product.name: Enterprise Vulnerability Remediation Workflow
product.tagline: Owner-led DevSecOps platform for remediation planning, governance, and execution
product.description: A workflow product that converts vulnerability reports into prioritized dashboards, ownership tagging, environment-aware planning, and execution hand-offs. It is built for regulated enterprise environments where remediation must be coordinated across application teams, infrastructure owners, and automation platforms without losing governance or traceability.
impact_points: Designed for large-scale remediation operations across 4,000+ servers in enterprise infrastructure.
Supports owner mapping, host tagging, exception tracking, patch sequencing, and mitigation planning.
Coordinates execution through Jira, GitHub, ServiceNow, Jenkins, REST APIs, and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform.
Enforces lower-environment-first patching to reduce production risk and improve release discipline.
Creates the foundation for agentic remediation and AI-assisted root-cause analysis when workflow steps fail.
